targetApplicants.text: The Institute of Innovation & Entrepreneurship’s home is the 4,811-square-foot ideaHUb incubator in the Leo A. Guthart Hall for Innovation and Discovery, which serves as a collaborative workspace for students, mentors, and startup companies. The ideaHUb runs a virtual and in-person New York State Certified Business Incubator . If you are interested in our state-of-the-art facility, please email us at: ideaHUb@hofstra.edu
